items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: You mentioned in the quotes in Stanley Dance's book that his approach was similar to your approach when you were playing guitar.

ctx.x: first time I heard Wes play I didn't know whether to run or what, stand up and run. I'd never heard anybody play a guitar like that, you know? And --
